name: review.nvim
description: Review GitLab merge requests and GitHub or Codeberg pull requests in an embedded Neovim session, with local comment drafts.

backend.reasoning: Runs your installed Neovim in a pseudo-terminal with the bundled review.nvim plugin and your Neovim configuration. Git and authenticated glab/gh or curl access the review host; comments stay local until explicitly submitted in Neovim.
